== Published English Original Virtual Set 4 wording ==
The original Walker Barrage clause limits the modifier to the same site, dispenses with weapon targeting and excludes random Jedi selection. The later slip prints a +2 total without those restrictions. Both keep the single control-phase card search, capacity, permanent pilot and immunity.
